data.one_liner: Flutter support and widgets for Wear OS devices.
data.what_it_does: Provides Flutter support for Wear OS by Google. It supplies specific widgets such as WatchShape to determine if the watch is square or round, and AmbientMode for handling ambient states.
use_when: You are developing a Flutter application targeting Wear OS smartwatches
You need to handle watch-specific shapes like square or round screens
You need to support ambient mode and active mode for watch faces
avoid_when: You are building a standard mobile or desktop application
You do not need native watch shape or ambient mode support
strengths: Actively maintained plugin for Wear OS
Provides essential watch-specific widgets like WatchShape and AmbientMode
weaknesses: Requires setting a minimum SDK version to 23
Limited to specific Wear OS capabilities documented in the README
data.setup_notes: Set your minSdkVersion to 23. If creating a standalone watch app, add the application meta-data for standalone to your manifest.
